# PREPARE DATASET

## Import datasets

```{r}
# Function to read and process gradients data
read_process_gradients <- function(session) {
  pc_read_session_gradient_matrices(session = session, data_root = paths$data_root)
}

# Function to create an empty matrix with specified dimensions and column names
create_empty_matrix <- function(ncol, nrow, cnames) {
  matrix(ncol = ncol, nrow = nrow, dimnames = list(NULL, cnames))
}

# Read and process gradients data for rs_2 and rs_3
rs_2_data <- read_process_gradients("rs2")
rs_3_data <- read_process_gradients("rs3")

# Create matrices for ec_parcel for rs_2 and rs_3
ec_parcel_rs_2 <- create_empty_matrix(400, length(rs_2_data$data), paste0('parcel', 1:400))
ec_parcel_rs_3 <- create_empty_matrix(400, length(rs_3_data$data), paste0('parcel', 1:400))

```

## DV dataset: Eccentricity

Calculate eccentricity for both rs_2 and rs_3 and combine them to make a dataset "df_ec_combined"

```{r}
# Function to process eccentricity data
process_eccentricity_data <- function(data, scan_label) {
  cnames <- paste0('parcel_', 1:400)
  ec_parcel <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(data$data), ncol = 400, dimnames = list(NULL, cnames))

  for (p in 1:400) {
    scores <- sapply(data$data, function(n) sqrt(n[p, 1]^2 + n[p, 2]^2 + n[p, 3]^2))
    ec_parcel[, p] <- scores
  }

  names <- data$participants
  ec_parcels <- data.frame('NECOS_ID' = names, ec_parcel)
  ec_parcels$scan <- rep(scan_label, nrow(ec_parcels))

  return(ec_parcels)
}

# Process eccentricity data for rs_2 and rs_3
ec_parcels_rs_2 <- process_eccentricity_data(rs_2_data, "rest2")
ec_parcels_rs_3 <- process_eccentricity_data(rs_3_data, "rest3")
#write_csv(ec_parcels_rs_2, file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "Processed_Data", "ec_parcels_rs_2.csv"))
#write_csv(ec_parcels_rs_3, file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "Processed_Data", "ec_parcels_rs_3.csv"))

# Combine eccentricity scores for rs_2 and rs_3 and match with NECOS_ID
df_ec_timepoints_combined <- rbind(ec_parcels_rs_2, ec_parcels_rs_3)

pc_write_csv(df_ec_timepoints_combined, file.path(tables_dir, "eccentricity_timepoints_combined.csv"))

```

## Combine the dataset DV & IV into one dataset

df_ec_timepoints_combined (eccentricity scores of both rs_2 and rs_3) + IV (including the stress, scan & headmotion)

```{r}
# Combine DV and IV datasets
df_DV_IV_combined <- merge(df_ec_timepoints_combined, IV, by.x = c("NECOS_ID", "scan"), by.y = c("ID", "scan"))

pc_write_csv(df_DV_IV_combined, file.path(tables_dir, "eccentricity_dv_iv_combined.csv"))

build_parcel_gradient_table <- function(parcel_number, rs2_bundle, rs3_bundle, iv_df) {
  rs2_df <- tibble(
    ID = rs2_bundle$participants,
    scan = "rest2",
    gradient1 = sapply(rs2_bundle$data, function(gradient_matrix) gradient_matrix[parcel_number, 1]),
    gradient2 = sapply(rs2_bundle$data, function(gradient_matrix) gradient_matrix[parcel_number, 2]),
    gradient3 = sapply(rs2_bundle$data, function(gradient_matrix) gradient_matrix[parcel_number, 3])
  )

  rs3_df <- tibble(
    ID = rs3_bundle$participants,
    scan = "rest3",
    gradient1 = sapply(rs3_bundle$data, function(gradient_matrix) gradient_matrix[parcel_number, 1]),
    gradient2 = sapply(rs3_bundle$data, function(gradient_matrix) gradient_matrix[parcel_number, 2]),
    gradient3 = sapply(rs3_bundle$data, function(gradient_matrix) gradient_matrix[parcel_number, 3])
  )

  bind_rows(rs2_df, rs3_df) %>%
    left_join(iv_df, by = c("ID", "scan"))
}

parcel_100_table <- build_parcel_gradient_table(100, rs_2_data, rs_3_data, IV)
parcel_377_table <- build_parcel_gradient_table(377, rs_2_data, rs_3_data, IV)

pc_write_csv(parcel_100_table, file.path(tables_dir, "eccentricity_parcel_100.csv"))
pc_write_csv(parcel_377_table, file.path(tables_dir, "eccentricity_parcel_377.csv"))

```

## 2. Define model

400 models (1 per parcel) parcel \~ stress \* scan + headmotion + (1 \| NECOS_ID)

```{r}
library(lmerTest)
library(afex)
library(purrr)

# Find columns that start with "parcel_"
dv_cols <- grep("^parcel_", colnames(df_DV_IV_combined))

# The remaining columns are considered as IVs
iv_cols <- setdiff(1:ncol(df_DV_IV_combined), dv_cols)

# Preallocate lists for storing models
all_models_lmm <- vector("list", length = length(dv_cols))
all_models_n_lmm <- vector("list", length = length(dv_cols))

# Loop to define models
for (i in seq_along(dv_cols)) {
  DV <- df_DV_IV_combined[, dv_cols[i]]
  IV <- df_DV_IV_combined[, iv_cols]
  
  combined_data <- cbind(DV, IV)
  colnames(combined_data)[1] <- "parcel"

  # Define models
  model <- mixed(parcel ~ stress * scan + headmotion + (1 | NECOS_ID), data = combined_data)
  model_n <- lme4::lmer(parcel ~ stress * scan + headmotion + (1 | NECOS_ID), data = combined_data)
  
  # Store models in the preallocated lists
  all_models_lmm[[i]] <- model
  all_models_n_lmm[[i]] <- model_n
}

# Naming the models
model_names <- colnames(df_DV_IV_combined[dv_cols])
names(all_models_lmm) <- model_names
names(all_models_n_lmm) <- model_names

# Summarize models
all_models_summary_lmm <- map(all_models_lmm, summary)
all_models_summary_n_lmm <- map(all_models_n_lmm, summary)

```

# 3. Check model assumptions

**a. normality of residuals**

```{r}

# Extract residuals from the model summaries
all_models_residuals <- map(all_models_summary_lmm, residuals)

# Define the file path for the PDF
pdf_file_path <- file.path(diag_qq_dir, "eccentricity_combined_residuals_qq_plots.pdf")
pdf(pdf_file_path)

# Generate and plot QQ plots for each set of residuals
map2(all_models_residuals, names(all_models_summary_lmm), function(residuals, model_name) {
  # Convert the residuals to a numeric vector, if necessary
  residuals_numeric <- as.numeric(unlist(residuals))
  
  # Filter out non-finite values
  residuals_numeric <- residuals_numeric[is.finite(residuals_numeric)]

  # Check if there are valid residuals to plot
  if (length(residuals_numeric) > 0) {
    qq_plot <- ggqqplot(residuals_numeric, title = paste("Model", model_name))
    print(qq_plot)  # Explicitly print the plot
  }
})

# Close the PDF file
dev.off()


```

**b. homoscadicity**

```{r}
# use the map function to plot all elements of the list

pdf(file.path(diag_resid_dir, "eccentricity_homoscedasticity_plots.pdf"))
map(all_models_n_lmm, function (i){
  plot(fitted(i), as.vector(residuals(i)) ) 
  abline(0, 0)
})
while (!is.null(dev.list()))  dev.off()
```

**c. independence (auto-correlation of the residuals)**

```{r}

library(car)


durbin_watson <- map(all_models_residuals, function (i){
  durbinWatsonTest(i)

})
durbin_watson <- as.data.frame(durbin_watson)
durbin_watson <- t(durbin_watson)
durbin_watson <- as.data.frame(durbin_watson)

pc_write_csv(durbin_watson, file.path(diagnostics_dir, "eccentricity_durbin_watson.csv"))

```

**d. multi-collinearity: Variance Inflation Factor (VIF)**

```{r}
library(purrr)
multicollinearity <- map(all_models_n_lmm, vif)

pc_write_csv(as.data.frame(multicollinearity), file.path(diagnostics_dir, "eccentricity_multicollinearity.csv"))


```

# 4. Model comparison

```{r}

# Function to create a simple model
create_simple_model <- function(df) {
  lmer(parcel ~ stress + scan + headmotion + (1 | NECOS_ID), data = df, REML = FALSE)
}

# Find columns that start with "parcel_"
dv_cols <- grep("^parcel_", colnames(df_DV_IV_combined))
iv_cols <- setdiff(1:ncol(df_DV_IV_combined), dv_cols)

# Preallocate list for storing simpler models
all_models_simple_lmm <- vector("list", length = length(dv_cols))

# Create simpler models for each DV
for (i in seq_along(dv_cols)) {
  DV <- df_DV_IV_combined[, dv_cols[i], drop = FALSE]
  IV <- df_DV_IV_combined[, iv_cols]
  
  combined_data <- cbind(DV, IV)
  colnames(combined_data)[1] <- "parcel"
  
  all_models_simple_lmm[[i]] <- create_simple_model(combined_data)
}
names(all_models_simple_lmm) <- colnames(df_DV_IV_combined[dv_cols])

# Assuming all_models_n_lmm contains the corresponding complex models
# Perform LRT model comparison
lrtest_results <- map2(all_models_n_lmm, all_models_simple_lmm, lrtest)

# Extract p-values
p_values <- map(lrtest_results, function(i) i[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"])

# Create a data frame for results
lrt_df <- tibble(Model = names(all_models_simple_lmm), P_Value = p_values)

# Write the results to a CSV file via the project-relative helpers when needed.


```

# Model summary, FDR-multimple comparisons and adding Schaefers 400 & Yeo's 7 parcellation 

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(stats)

# Read parcel labels
parcel_labels <- pc_parcel_labels(paths$data_root)

# Add 'parcel' column with labels in the pattern 'parcel_1', 'parcel_2', ...
parcel_labels$parcel <- paste0("parcel_", 1:nrow(parcel_labels))

# Custom function to safely extract data from a mixed model summary
extract_model_data <- function(model, model_name) {
  model_summary <- summary(model)
  
  # Check if there are coefficients
  if (!is.null(model_summary$coefficients)) {
    df <- data.frame(
      Model = rep(model_name, nrow(model_summary$coefficients)),
      Term = rownames(model_summary$coefficients),
      Estimate = model_summary$coefficients[, "Estimate"],
      StdError = model_summary$coefficients[, "Std. Error"],
      DF = model_summary$coefficients[, "df"],
      tValue = model_summary$coefficients[, "t value"],
      pValue = model_summary$coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  } else {
    # Create an empty data frame with the same columns
    df <- data.frame(
      Model = model_name,
      Term = NA,
      Estimate = NA,
      StdError = NA,
      DF = NA,
      tValue = NA,
      pValue = NA
    )
  }
  return(df)
}

# Extract data from all models
model_names <- names(all_models_lmm)
model_data_list <- map2(all_models_lmm, model_names, extract_model_data)

# Combine all model data into one dataframe
combined_model_data <- bind_rows(model_data_list)

# Merge with parcel labels
combined_model_data <- left_join(combined_model_data, parcel_labels, by = c("Model" = "parcel"))

# Adjust p-values using FDR method
combined_model_data$p.value.adj <- p.adjust(combined_model_data$pValue, method = "fdr")

# Add a significance column
combined_model_data$Significance <- ifelse(combined_model_data$p.value.adj < 0.05, "*", "")

# Save to CSV
pc_write_csv(combined_model_data, file.path(models_dir, "eccentricity_all_models_with_labels.csv"))

# Filter rows with the interaction term "stress:scan1"
interaction_data <- combined_model_data %>%
  filter(Term == "stress:scan1")



```
